texts: Sky-cats hunted at the Sunken Cove on day 667, on day 668 and on day 669 of Year 2.
On day 670 of Year 2, Bevin Coombe asked the Council for permission to burn wintergloss at the Stilllight Lantern for one night.
Bevin Coombe added wintergloss to the Stilllight Lantern at sundown.
The Stilllight Lantern burned wintergloss alongside mire-essence.
The wintergloss repelled nightmoths from the Stilllight Lantern.
Bevin Coombe counted three nightmoths at the Stilllight Lantern that night.
About twelve nightmoths gather at the Stilllight Lantern on a normal night.
The sky-cats did not descend into the Sunken Cove that night.
Bevin Coombe reported the result to the Council.

q1_issues.issue: "asked the Council for permission" puts the for-PP object in Theme, but a prepositional verb's object takes the preposition-named oblique, never a direct-object role.
The complement of "permission to burn" is headed For rather than the preposition actually used (To), which the head-selection rule forbids as a near-fit synonym head.

"About twelve" is encoded as (Cardinality sk_moths_3 (ParticleFromNormal 12 1.2)), but Cardinality is specified to take a native integer and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure magnitude and Time hour slots.

The strength-0 group denial for "the sky-cats did not descend" omits the accompanying strength-0 per-member distribution rule that a negated plural or group must also emit (descend is not a collective predicate).
The three hunting events over the bare-plural group sk_group_1 emit no per-member distribution rule, although hunt is not one of the collective/aggregate predicates that stay group-only.

"on a normal night" is placed in the Time slot as a witness sk_night_1 carrying (Member sk_night_1 night) and (Member sk_night_1 normal), while the Time role is defined to take structured calendar terms or bare constants only.

q2_gaps: a day-of-year numbering ("on day 667 ... of Year 2") - (Day n) is defined as a within-month granularity beside Month/Year, and no term covers days counted across a whole year, so (Day 667) will not interoperate with the seeded day/month ordering rules

an approximated count ("about twelve nightmoths") - Cardinality takes a native integer, CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost take a bound, and CardinalityPhrase takes a canonical vague phrase; a hedged numeral count has no licensed form

a typicality-restricted habitual occasion ("on a normal night") - the habitual machinery covers named slots, Every periods and TimesPer rates, but nothing restricts a habitual to typical/normal occasions
review.notes: The proposed burn is correctly reified tenseless as the non-asserted complement, "the Council" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default with no Name, and "that night" propagation copies Day 670 / Year 2 plus the day-part exactly as specified. Resolving "the test" to the burn event sk_burn_1 (and typing it (Member sk_burn_1 test)) is a bridging inference the text does not spell out, though it is applied consistently for both "approved" and "recorded".

issues.reason: Thematic roles states that a prepositional verb's object takes the preposition's oblique and never a direct-object role ("referred to the memo", "dealt with the appeal"), and the Beneficiary bullet routes a non-benefit "for" to the preposition-named (For <event> …), so "asked … for permission" cannot be a Theme.

The head must be the preposition actually used — never a synonym head for a near-fit reading — and the instruction set already renders an infinitival "to" as the head To ("knelt to check the drain" → (To sk_kneel_1 sk_check_1)), so "permission to burn" takes To, not For.

Cardinality's count slot is specified as a native integer and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only as a Measure-family magnitude or a Time term's value, so (Cardinality sk_moths_3 (ParticleFromNormal 12 1.2)) is ill-typed per the vocabulary — the calibration line makes an ill-typed atom a defect even in gap territory.

Negation (events) states that a negated plural or group keeps BOTH emissions — the strength-0 group bundle and the strength-0 per-member rule ("The kegs do not ferment") — and descend is not a reciprocal/aggregate predicate, so dropping the rule states a weaker claim than the sentence.

Quantifiers, generics & scope has the same rule form distribute a distributive predicate over a plural or group, and hunt is not among the collective predicates (gather / meet / assemble / collide) that stay group-only, so each of the three hunt events owes a per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1).

The observation stands — the Time role's documented fillers are structured calendar terms, deictic/named constants and day-part symbols, and the same parse puts the bare constant night in that slot for "that night", so the two forms will not match — but calling it a violation overstates: the instruction set does not cover a typicality-restricted habitual occasion (the reviewer's own third gap), every atom emitted is true of the sentence and well-typed, and a bare night constant would silently drop the stated "normal" restriction.

gaps_confirmed: a day-of-year numbering ("on day 667 … of Year 2"): (Day <n>) is a within-month granularity beside Month/Year, so a day counted across a whole year has no term and will not interoperate with the seeded day/month ordering rules

a hedged exact count ("about twelve nightmoths"): Cardinality takes a native integer, CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost take a bound the hedge does not state, and CardinalityPhrase takes a canonical vague-lexicon word
a typicality-restricted habitual occasion ("on a normal night"): the habitual machinery covers named slots, Every periods and TimesPer rates, but nothing restricts a habitual to typical occasions
new_gaps: coordinated date adjuncts on one clause ("hunted at the Sunken Cove on day 667, on day 668 and on day 669"): Coordination & plurals covers coordinated clauses, VPs and NPs but not coordinated time adjuncts, so nothing licenses replicating the event once per date — and the one-event alternative (three Day terms on one event) would be false

a surface-lemma duration unit ("for one night" → (Measure e duration 1 night)): the unit is the stated word as required, but night is outside the seeded second-canonical lexicon, so the duration cannot be compared or thresholded against hour/day durations
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form for "asked the Council for permission" is the preposition-named oblique (For sk_ask_1 sk_permission_1) with no Theme on the ask event; "permission to burn" takes the preposition actually used, (To sk_permission_1 sk_burn_1); for "about twelve" the instruction set licenses NO form that carries a hedged count, so the compliant parse emits the group and its GroupOf with no count atom at all and records the gap; the denial needs (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_descend $x) descend) (Agent (sk_descend $x) $x) (Goal (sk_descend $x) sunken_cove) (Past (sk_descend $x)) (Time (sk_descend $x) (Day 670)) (Time (sk_descend $x) (Year 2)) (Time (sk_descend $x) night))) at (STV 0.0 0.9) beside the strength-0 group bundle; and each of the three hunt events needs its per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) at (STV 1.0 0.9).
adjudication.notes: The tenseless reification of the proposed burn, the no-Name treatment of "the Council", the "that night" term propagation and the Alongside / Source / Goal preposition choices are all correct. Resolving "the test" to sk_burn_1 and typing it (Member sk_burn_1 test) is a coreference judgment the text supports and is applied consistently, so I do not treat it as a defect.
